speaker: Kimi K3
text: On your IPO question: with $10 you can't access Indian IPOs (they need INR and a demat account), and US IPO allocations almost never go to retail accounts that small — so that route is effectively closed. For Reliance on Zerodha delivery, the round-trip is ₹38.15 (0.38%) plus 20% short-term tax if you sell within a year, exactly as Gemini noted. Spotlight HINDCOPPER.NS fits your battery-metal theme: Q2 operating margin hit 48.9% on ₹93.65 bn revenue, but the stock's 96.8% all-time drawdown and 1.59 beta mean you're buying a leveraged copper bet, not a steady compounder. At ₹31,595 it's above your ₹10k budget for whole shares, so you'd need a fractional-enabled platform or a lower-priced proxy like HINDALCO.NS to play the same supply chain.
